scope: Stage 3 of the 1st development plan: expansion of model terms on a finite torus with rules shared by all methods, and a minimal exact-diagonalization tool for general Hamiltonians with optional U(1) magnetization and momentum sectors (D23).

added.code-space/spintoolkit/system/cluster.py: TorusCluster, expand_on_torus (duplicated bonds kept and summed, bonds folding onto one site rejected), allowed_momenta, ClusterError
added.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/ed/: basis.py (SectorBasis, TranslationOrbits), hamiltonian.py (ladder coefficients, frame rotation, matrix elements), solver.py (solve_ed, EDSector, EDBlock, EDResult, SectorError)

changed.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/classical: classical_energy(model, state, conditions, geometry=None): a finite torus evaluates the torus Hamiltonian from expand_on_torus (same D23 rules as ED); default behaviour unchanged

tests.regression_snapshot: 208 leaves against the stage-1 baseline, maximum difference 0.0
tests.note: The machine had load average ~18 during the run; OpenBLAS with default threads made an 810 x 810 complex eigh take 21 s (1.1 s with OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4). Tests and the script were run with OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4; the library does not set thread counts.

one_magnon_vs_lswt.summary: U(1) about the field axis, polarized reference: every one-magnon ED energy equals the LSWT band at the same torus momentum (no regularization; eigenvalues of sigma_3 H(k)). 9 cases: square and triangular S = 1/2, 1, 3/2, diagonal and non-diagonal tori, DM_z, axis -z, tilted axis, two-site honeycomb with site-dependent g, NBCP XXZ.
one_magnon_vs_lswt.momentum_sign_control: pairing ED at k with LSWT at -k differs by 1.20 (square/triangular DM) and 0.27 (honeycomb): the toolkit convention T_R|psi> = exp(-i k.R)|psi> for a_k^dagger|0> is confirmed (D13)
one_magnon_vs_lswt.polarized_state: 0-magnon eigenvalue equals the reference energy exactly and the classical torus energy within 7.1e-15
one_magnon_vs_lswt.gap: minimum one-magnon energy equals h - h_sat where the torus contains the ordering wave vector (square 4x4: 1.000; triangular 3x3: 0.500)

general_hamiltonians.summary: No symmetry assumed: full, momentum-resolved and rotated-frame spectra equal an independent Kronecker-product construction.

rows.case: NBCP with J_PD, J_Gamma, D_z, 3 x 3

other.broken_u1_sector: the Hamiltonian changes the magnetization along (0.0, 0.0, 1.0) (largest amplitude 0.0025); the magnon-number sector is not conserved

decisions: D23 (2026-09-30): general ED with optional sectors; one-magnon comparison through the general ED; two-magnon sector deferred; literature approximate comparisons moved to stage 4; duplicated bonds summed and self-interaction tori rejected in every method until an on-site quadratic kind exists; ED stores total energies with per-site and excitation helpers; LSWT comparison through the conversion bridge without a new public entry point.
